title: Editorial / 编辑杂志
referenceRole: 实际网页截图，仅作排版与风格参考；业务内容沿用资源管理场景。
prompt:
Create one high fidelity desktop B2B component library style exploration mockup, variant G "Editorial / 编辑杂志", a single polished flat UI screenshot, landscape around 1600x1100. All UI Chinese, crisp and legible. This is a design candidate for Mono Design, not a marketing site.
REFERENCE: attached actual screenshot from StyleKit Editorial showcase. Extract warm ivory, soft black, serif editorial hierarchy, precise thin horizontal rules, underline form fields, whitespace. Do not reproduce its contact page, personal data, photos, marketing hero or giant lettering. Translate its typography and restraint into a useful enterprise workbench.
STYLE: background #F9F8F6 warm ivory, soft black #1C1C1C, warm gray fine dividers. Main page title and section titles use refined normal-weight Chinese serif Songti/Noto Serif SC; English Mono logotype elegant serif. Body, tables, labels and controls use highly readable Chinese sans serif. Title about32px rather than a huge hero. Restrained small uppercase English section captions optional. Fine 1px rules, sharp rectangular corners, generous but workable spacing. No colored accent at all, no blue, pink, green or red. No shadows, gradients, neumorphism, photos or decorative geometries. Main actions solid soft black, secondary actions fine outlines or underlined text. Avoid heavy black boxed table grid or black table header slab. Status and error use distinct symbols AND text; error is warm black "! 请填写资源名称" with stronger underline, not color. Selected row pale warm gray plus visible check.
COMPOSITION matches previous candidates: sidebar about170px; main workspace includes page heading and filters, then organization tree about150px + wide data table about650px + right new-resource form about330px. Bottom component specimen strip around230px height inside main area. Thin dividers instead of card nesting. Use sufficient left/rightpadding, no cramped labels. Broad clear workspace, magazine-like fine section numbering 01/02/03 if useful but don't clutter.
SIDEBAR logo "Mono", small subtitle "DESIGN SYSTEM"; navigation "概览", "资源管理" active with thin left black rule and subtle warmgray background, "组件规范", "设置".
PAGE heading "资源管理", subtitle "管理团队资源与访问状态". Top tiny "WORKSPACE / RESOURCES", optional right "G / EDITORIAL". Filters: search "搜索资源", dropdown "全部状态", date range "2026/10/01 — 2026/10/31", black button "+ 新增资源".
TREE heading "团队"; expanded "产品组" children "产品文档" selected, "需求资料"; "设计组"; "工程组"; thin branchlines.
TABLE heading resource list, columns checkbox / "资源名称" / "负责人" / "状态" / "更新时间". Exactly four rows: "设计规范 v1" "林然" "已启用" "2026/10/18"; "组件清单" "陈一" "草稿" "2026/10/16"; "交付检查" "周宁" "已启用" "2026/10/12"; "测试数据" "李明" "已停用" "2026/10/10". One selected row checked with pale warmgray tint. Status labels monochrome with filled dot, hollow dot, dash distinct. Row actions small ellipsis. Tablefooter "共 4 条" pagination "< 1 >". Fine row rules, no vertical boxed grid.
RIGHT FORM titled "新建资源" in normalweight serif. Labels and underline inputs: "资源名称", empty "请输入资源名称" and visible "! 请填写资源名称"; "负责人" with "请选择负责人"; "资源分类" with "产品文档". Upload area fine dashed warmgray border "上传附件" and file row "design-spec.pdf" "2.4 MB". Bottom "取消" secondary + "保存" softblackprimary.
BOTTOM separated by a fine rule heading "组件状态" and small "COMPONENT NOTES". Three ordered sections. Buttons and inputs: "主要操作" black, "次要操作" outline, disabled muted; inputs "默认输入", active/focus underline thicker, error "! 请填写". Choice controls: checked checkbox "已选择", unchecked "未选择", radio, tiny on/off switch in monochrome. A compact believable October2026 calendar "2026年10月", weekdays 一 二 三 四 五 六 日, 1 starts Thursday and selected22 isThursday, clearly legible date grid. Include status specimens "已启用", "草稿", "已停用" nearcontrols. Fit everything within one image.
QUALITY: professional editorial enterprise system, strong typographic hierarchy, intentional blankspace, all business controls present, crisp thin icons, calm tactile warm paper impression but SOLID flat untextured background. Preserve functional density. No device frame, no perspective, no image outside screen, no large marketing text, no additional pages.

selection.basis: 用户明确选择 Editorial 编辑杂志风为整库最终方向
selection.note: 原始生成提示词与图片保持不变；这是视觉方向批准，不代表实际组件验收。
